notes: Configuration measured_no_payload: the weight log of the Master Specification Sheet (1st Airframe), positions from CG Calcs 1 forward tank. No payload and no water tanks.
The mass is the sum of the weighed subassembly totals. The CG x comes from the position sheet. y = 0 and z = 0 for every point mass: the sheet has no vertical positions (stand-in).
The inertia is the parallel-axis sum of the point masses. A part has no inertia of its own in it.
S, b and c: the CUSTOM reference dimensions of the flow5 T7 analysis t7_reference.xml.
The design frame origin is the flow5 origin. Its offset from the nose is not recorded.
MRP = the CoG of the T7 analysis (the nominal CG). It is a mass model value (placeholder).

performance.name: sizing
performance.description: Initial sizing of the aircraft (the first design stage). Unit checks: b^2/S = 9.6243 = AR 9.6243: S in m^2 and b in m (or both in one other unit); the mass parts sum to m_total 8.0228; C_D_i + C_D_o = C_D; C_L / C_D = glide ratio

tools.description: Printout of the sizing scripts. The printout gives no units: see units_basis of each output (AeroPlan tools/aerosandbox/spoke.py).

requirements.acceptance_criteria: The aircraft flies every item and lands. The flight ends disarmed.
